title: Scentree: a framework for generating scenario trees for multistage stochastic programming
abstract: arXiv:2609.21495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present scentree, an open-source Python package for constructing a scenario fan and a scenario tree for multistage stochastic programming from historical data. It combines machine learning and multivariate time series models to obtain a scenario fan that captures inter-stage dependencies in the stochastic processes. This scenario fan is subsequently transformed into a scenario tree suitable for multistage stochastic optimization, providing a flexible and extensible framework for uncertainty modeling. A key contribution is the automation of the complete workflow, including model selection, parameter estimation, scenario fan generation, and scenario tree construction. Scentree does not rely on assumptions about the underlying data distribution, reducing the statistical expertise required to produce a scenario tree. Furthermore, it is agnostic to the specific multistage stochastic problem to be solved.

translated_title: Scentree：一个用于多阶段随机规划的场景树生成框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了scentree，一个开源Python包，用于从历史数据构建适用于多阶段随机规划的场景扇和场景树。它结合机器学习和多元时间序列模型来获得能够捕捉随机过程中阶段间依赖关系的场景扇。该场景扇随后被转换为适用于多阶段随机优化的场景树，为不确定性建模提供了一个灵活且可扩展的框架。其关键贡献之一是自动化了完整的工作流程，包括模型选择、参数估计、场景扇生成和场景树构建。Scentree不依赖对底层数据分布的假设，降低了生成场景树所需的统计专业知识门槛。此外，它与所要解决的具体多阶段随机问题无关，具有通用性。
tldr: Scentree是一个开源Python框架，通过结合机器学习与多元时间序列模型，从历史数据自动生成适用于多阶段随机规划的场景树，无需数据分布假设且与具体优化问题无关。
en_tdlr: Scentree is an open-source Python framework that automatically generates scenario trees for multistage stochastic programming from historical data by combining machine learning and multivariate time series models, without distributional assumptions and independent of the specific optimization problem.
